dexEntries.Discovered: A green, omnivorous scout. It seems to never be alone, always with a buddy.
dexEntries.First Caught: Erbacub roams the forest gathering leaves and twigs, often seen tying them together with vines. It seems eager to prove itself, though its paws still tremble in battle. Erbacub almost never travels alone.
dexEntries.Experienced: Erbacub is a loyal scout, part of a troop of Erbacubs like itself. They train so that one day, they may take care of the forest. Until then, they make mud cookies, try to avoid tying together tools, and ward off scary felines from their campsites.
dexEntries.Callside: A starter looking so similar to, you know, is a bit risky. I guess it paid off!

sacred.name: Sacred Erbacub
sacred.visualDescription: An Erbacub covered in earned badges and patches, carrying a pocket knife.

dexEntries.First Caught: Bearosion patrols forests like a ranger. Its safari hat never falls off, even during battle. It exudes leadership and calm strength.
Hileaph towers over the forest, wielding a fallen tree. Its wide-brim safari hat casts a long shadow, under which others gather for safety.

dexEntries.Discovered: A red, overly playful ???. It jumps and runs around, mindlessly leaving flames everywhere it goes.
dexEntries.First Caught: Sparcoon never pays attention to where it goes. If it can see somewhere it can jump to, it will. Despite being a land animal, it appears to enjoy using its tail to boost itself upwards. Sparcoons, nonetheless, are friendly.
dexEntries.Experienced: Sparcoon is a trusted, though incompetent creature. It seems not to register the amount of damage it causes by spreading fires wherever it decides to go, and it moves around quite often. Sparcoons never stay in one spot, so seeing the same wild Sparcoon twice should be considered highly lucky.
dexEntries.Callside: Would you believe that these fire raccoons were originally named Charcoon? I agree.

dexEntries.First Caught: Blazuki glides across tall heights and long distances, leaving streaks of embers in the air. Its fiery mohawk flares up even further when it flies, warning others of its incoming presence.

dexEntries.Discovered: A blue, adorable chibi. It noticeably struggles to pick up its head due to the crystals growing out of it.
dexEntries.First Caught: Axolitl is often seen with its head dipped low. A mysterious crystal grows where its gills should be, making it difficult to lift its head above water. The crystal pulses faintly when it feels safe.

sacred.name: Sacred Axolitl
sacred.visualDescription: It has extra crystals, improved posture, and Godzilla-like crystals along its body.

dexEntries.First Caught: Axolote loses it's once gentle movements and now have an alien quality to them. It now also appears to mutter to itself in an unknown language.

sacred.name: Sacred Axolote
sacred.visualDescription: Its upper torso is thinner, resembling a normal Axolarg.

sacred.name: Sacred Axolarg
sacred.visualDescription: It wears a bulky Venom-like suit with two thinner arms extending from its back.

dexEntries.First Caught: Axolarg towers above its foes, with a hulking physique sculpted by its crystalline armor. The only part of its body not encased in crystals is its head, and a floating crystal hovers above it, pulsing with mysterious energy.

sacred.name: Sacred Bakunbush
sacred.visualDescription: Small branches and vine-like limbs grow grapes. It controls them like extra arms to whip, grab objects, or throw grapes at enemies from a distance.

sacred.name: Sacred Pigturee
sacred.visualDescription: It has a longer, spikier tree-like trunk extension covered in bushy moss and even more grapevines, one of which curls into a grape goatee.

sacred.name: Sacred Statipillar
sacred.visualDescription: The red variants wear gold plates and the orange variants wear silver plates to conduct more electricity. They wear copper rope to keep themselves grounded, resembling centipedes more than caterpillars. Their electricity is white-blue and they appear more focused.

dexEntries.First Caught: Dribsom lurks in alleys and caves, its wings flapping silently as it watches from the shadows. Despite its small size, it's known for stealing food and vanishing into the night sky with a hiss-like screech. They also pick on small prey in the nighttime.

sacred.name: Sacred Ircencaat
sacred.visualDescription: Two Ircencaats share a trench coat, with one holding the other up to appear larger and more intimidating.

sacred.name: Sacred Confished
sacred.visualDescription: The pair works as a team instead of being equal in size or function. One is large and intimidating, while the long, lanky other hides behind it like a tail and strikes escaping or unsuspecting prey.

sacred.name: Sacred Cartilicht
sacred.visualDescription: It uses blacklight to remain less obvious, attract prey, and see better in the dark.

base.name: Salgee

dexEntries.First Caught: It slept at the bottom of the river for so long that algae grew over its body.

base.visualDescription: A sage-like fish with algae growing over its body.

sacred.name: Sacred Chordal
sacred.visualDescription: It has a larger harp and hand-like fins that let it play faster, pluck multiple strings, and perform more complex songs.

base.name: Triangeel

dexEntries.First Caught: It strikes itself with its tail to make sound.

base.visualDescription: An eel shaped like a triangle.

base.name: Basscsio
base.visualDescription: A seahorse resembling a bassoon.

base.name: Velvetone
base.visualDescription: A red velvetfish resembling an Electone organ.

base.name: Spigle
base.visualDescription: A shortspine thornyhead resembling a bugle.

base.name: Moshrill
base.visualDescription: Hyperactive, jumpy bugs with thick exoskeletons resembling skulls and glowing neon accents. Their ribbed shells rub together while they mosh, producing a sound like a heavy-metal scream.

base.name: Pyroad

dexEntries.First Caught: Its tail acts as a fuse, igniting the explosive attached to it and launching Pyroad forward.

base.visualDescription: A roadrunner with flame-igniting feet and a tail connected to a bomb or stick of dynamite.

base.name: Calloyte

dexEntries.First Caught: It eats Pyroads to trigger an explosion inside itself, which provides its energy.

base.visualDescription: A coyote resembling a metal firelighter.

base.name: Flikflek
base.visualDescription: A kangaroo rat with a tennis racket at the end of its tail.

base.name: Kangurru
base.visualDescription: A large kangaroo rat resembling a kangaroo, with a tennis racket at the end of its tail and a Flikflek in its pouch carrying another racket.

base.name: Hachit
base.visualDescription: A baby scorpion with an axe-shaped tail and tiny single-line claws used to hold things in place.

base.name: Cluchit
base.visualDescription: A medium-sized scorpion with an axe-shaped tail, normal scorpion claws, and tiny needles all over its body that weaken an opponent's grip.

base.name: Graspit
base.visualDescription: A large scorpion with three tails. Its left and right tails act as shackles that lock onto limbs, while its center tail resembles Cluchit's. Heavy, stone-like armor covers its main body.

base.name: Limirail
base.visualDescription: A toy train-like creature whose size and apparent distance change depending on how its observer perceives it.

base.name: Chiplus

dexEntries.First Caught: It creates mirages that duplicate its appearance.

base.visualDescription: A chipmunk.

base.name: Nudinde
base.visualDescription: A small slug riding a dandelion, with gills that imitate the dandelion's puffs.

base.name: Doereme
base.visualDescription: A doe wearing a sleeping cap, with fur resembling a blanket.

base.name: Bamzai
base.visualDescription: A small bonsai plant with a sapling growing from its top.

ace.name: Ace Bamzaiken/Bamzumo
ace.visualDescription: A huge, hulking humanoid flowerpot with a beanstalk growing from its top. It carries two scythes shaped like a pair of scissors.

base.name: Bamzaiken

dexEntries.First Caught: It can fire energy slashes from its scythe.

base.visualDescription: A humanoid flowerpot with a cherry tree growing from its top. It carries a scythe shaped somewhat like a hoe.

sacred.name: Sacred Saplite
sacred.visualDescription: Its squid-like vine legs are longer. Its head has an edamame mohawk, and it can shoot edamame beans from its mouth.

sacred.name: Sacred Dreadbloom
sacred.visualDescription: It can brighten, darken, or change its color to camouflage itself and attract things. Its teeth and stem are much longer.

sacred.name: Sacred Rosophagus
sacred.visualDescription: Its stem is longer and it has additional leaves resembling a bellflower. It has a retractable uvula used to disorient creatures before catching and eating them.

sacred.name: Sacred Pollutron
sacred.visualDescription: Its vines are longer, and its sides contain cannons that fire coconuts.

base.name: Bewag
base.visualDescription: A red fleshy ghost, giving a slight transparent (but not actually) effect. The limbs are stretched beyond human-like, and the eyes are hollowed out.

base.name: Shiver Shocks
base.visualDescription: Looks extremely similar to Nonignite, however is notable a robot version. Rather than being a lava lamp, it is a plasma lamp. The suckers on it's tentacles are now defibrillators. Instead of the UPRO logo (on the current model), it has a yellow cross. Shiver Shocks is used for heart support, which is why it is found in hospitals and sometimes buildings, homes, and schools.

base.name: Frankfortress
base.visualDescription: A fortress made of hotdog/sausages. I'm sure this isn't that hard to conceptualize.

sacred.name: Sacred Starpod
sacred.visualDescription: It has a giant bubble blower on its back resembling a frog's throat sac. When sufficiently inflated, it releases a massive bubble that refracts light around it and renders it effectively invisible.

base.name: Aurumaton

dexEntries.First Caught: Each time it is struck, more of its body turns golden.

base.visualDescription: A huge clay golem with golden repairs spreading across its body.

base.name: Cannitil
base.visualDescription: A large, moderately round stone with a strange face chiseled into it. It can float but usually rolls to avoid cracking itself from the strain.

base.name: Aggranite
base.visualDescription: A much larger version of Cannitil, resembling a boulder. It coats itself in mud to avoid chipping while it flies.

base.name: Runaiolate
base.visualDescription: An Aggranite permanently coated in Sub-Lava. It resembles obsidian and spins with tremendous speed.

base.name: Babahl
base.visualDescription: A goat whose horns curve far enough for it to roll on them.

base.name: Robenhoodie
base.visualDescription: A caped robin that fires its feathers.

base.name: Beakon
base.visualDescription: A frigatebird that fires a laser beam.

base.name: Scregling
base.visualDescription: A small creature with broad flying-fish wings instead of arms, dense photosynthetic fur that grows greener and brighter with sunlight, a smooth bioluminescent face, and a bare bone-like jaw.

base.name: Hexkwet
base.visualDescription: A mountain bird that attacks with its own shadow and can become a shadow to rest. Its bald head appears to have no skin, exposing only its skull.

base.name: Vultumbra
base.visualDescription: A bird with an enormous wingspan and light-absorbing feathers that prevent light from passing through. It has Ghouliath's skull and can wrap itself in its wings to merge with darkness and travel between shadows.

base.name: Aguipesh
base.visualDescription: A water panther represented as an oversized lynx with subtle draconic traits and dorsal plates along the top of its body.

base.name: Thundrake
base.visualDescription: A thunderbird represented as a brightly colored bird with a serious brow and lightning radiating from its body. It has feathered pterodactyl-like wings, and its head and neck can twist completely around beyond the range of an owl.

base.name: Soxafone
base.visualDescription: A sock shaped like a saxophone.

sacred.name: Sacred Paranger
sacred.visualDescription: It uses static electricity through its clothing to discourage people from touching it or trying on the merchandise. It may wear gloves that project an electric field, and the face above it appears more concentrated.

sacred.name: Sacred Fonceer
sacred.visualDescription: Its pocket watch hangs from its waist. It carries a magician's cane and performs a magic trick with a lighter while smoking a cigar. The face above it appears more concentrated.

sacred.name: Sacred Dressiani
sacred.visualDescription: Her outer layer is visible around the clothing. Her moisturized body, a figment of light taking human form, can extend through partially visible, reflective liquid movement.

base.name: Vigilith
base.visualDescription: Blindfold (for see no evil), similar design to Statue of Liberty (Green-Orange Designs, Dress, Crown), and not as beanish.

base.name: Signilith
base.visualDescription: Gag-esque feature (for say no evil), similar design to Lincoln Memorial, openable chest cavity with Huge Bell inside (Liberty Bell), Arms and Legs like Insane Asylum. (It also is in a curled up pose)

base.name: Agilith
base.visualDescription: Destroyed/Cracked Ear Holes (for hear no evil), similar design to Freedom (White, Dress, Crown), and can should imply being able to compress and extend.

base.name: Serventine
base.visualDescription: A male cobra dressed as a butler.

base.name: Maidusa
base.visualDescription: A female cobra dressed as a maid.

base.name: Antendett
base.visualDescription: An ant dressed as a waiter.

base.name: Mulchimaw

dexEntries.First Caught: Its body is made of rotting plants and releases a horrid smell.

base.visualDescription: A small dragon with an unusually long neck, thorns for horns, and mushrooms growing from its neck to its head.

base.name: Detritan

dexEntries.First Caught: It causes decay around itself to gather more material for its body. Because its accumulated plant matter makes movement difficult, it spends most of its time in murky water to keep itself damp. Some call it a monster of the bodies of water it inhabits.

base.visualDescription: A large dragon whose body is made from a landfill's worth of decaying plants, with mushrooms and thorns protruding all over it.

base.name: Tenwreck
base.visualDescription: A small, fierce electric mammal with electric spines. Its dropped spines illuminate its underground home, and the spines glow like an overloaded lightbulb when it becomes angry.

base.name: Voltum
base.visualDescription: An electrically charged hummingbird that zigzags through the air like lightning. Its wings glow hot with sparks as it constantly releases energy.

base.name: Walmare
base.visualDescription: A Trojan-horse virus that takes the form of any living party member. Its default form is a horse made of Corrupted Ice.

base.name: Macarino
base.visualDescription: A rhinoceros made of macaroni and cheese. Its humps are melted cheese, while the rest of its body is pasta.

base.name: Canvox
base.visualDescription: A fox made of paint with a thistle for a tail.

base.name: Briste
base.visualDescription: A floating paintbrush.

base.name: Markara
base.description: As the Paragon of Freedom, she compels individuality and self-expression. She covers surfaces with murals, graffiti, and symbols that reflect the identities, emotions, and stories of those around her. Yet freedom is also her burden. She refuses to be defined by any rule, expectation, style, or identity, constantly reinventing her ideals, art, and personality.
base.visualDescription: A female Animate composed of what is believed to be fire, despite it constantly changing color. She wears red sneakers, a tie-dye cropped hoodie, athletic shorts, a black cap, and black fingerless gloves. Her hair resembles a plume of spread-out spray paint.

goner.name: Nostralatu

dexEntries.First Caught: It seeks out smells, but once it has smelled something specific, it never seeks out that scent again. Garlic is deadly to it.

goner.visualDescription: A vampire with a large nose and a traditional vampire cloak shaped somewhat like a nose silhouette.

goner.name: Quillcoil
goner.visualDescription: A robotic porcupine with a magnetic back. It reverses its magnetism to fire the metal rods from its back and then draws them in again.

goner.name: Shiver Pests
goner.visualDescription: Extremely small bug creatures, comparable in design but not based off of Prismite in universe or irl. They are extremely small, and only appear as black dots to the naked eye. However, they may fuse together as little nanobots to do tasks, similarly to ants.

goner.name: Shiver Vlogs
goner.visualDescription: Based off of Sapphae, however her Sapphire head is instead replaced with a camera, with a great focusing lens.

sacred.name: Sacred Krat
sacred.visualDescription: Instead of swinging and hopping wildly, it balances calmly on one leg with an upright posture.

sacred.name: Sacred Kroxer
sacred.visualDescription: It wears white bandanas, including one covering its eyes, and balances on one leg with a leaner build and more defined leg muscles.

goner.name: Slurpent
goner.visualDescription: An extremely long silly staw snake. That's really it.

goner.name: Growool
goner.visualDescription: A small wolf pup with the legs of a lamb.

goner.name: Furgery
goner.visualDescription: A sheep wearing a frightening wolf or dog costume.

goner.name: Weredyagoat
goner.visualDescription: A wendigo wearing a werewolf costume. The costume's head is beginning to tear, revealing parts of the skull beneath it.

goner.name: Alpacalypse
goner.visualDescription: A huge, peaceful alpaca with a long neck and dark, rolling storm-cloud fleece. It may have a third eye and is regarded as an omen of the end of the world.

goner.name: Anchophant
goner.visualDescription: A small desert elephant with extremely long tusks that it drives into the ground to launch itself through the air.

goner.name: Lambabeem
goner.visualDescription: A sheep with colored glass instead of wool and a lightbulb in its back that illuminates the night.

goner.name: Purrl
goner.visualDescription: A knitted ball or hacky sack resembling a cat.

goner.name: Knitten
goner.visualDescription: A cat-shaped plush made entirely from knitted fabric.

dexEntries.First Caught: It is grumpy because it cannot get any sleep.

goner.name: Teepy
goner.visualDescription: A teepee made of toilet paper.

goner.name: Minnote

dexEntries.First Caught: It evolves based on the primary instrument it most recently heard.

goner.visualDescription: A minnow shaped like a bass clef symbol.
